description: This file contains utility functions for Cypress end-to-end testing of the Superset frontend, specifically related to chart exploration, filtering, dashboard interactions, and API request interception.

methods.name: interceptFiltering
methods.description: Sets up Cypress intercept for filtering API calls.

methods.name: interceptBulkDelete
methods.description: Sets up Cypress intercept for bulk delete chart API calls.

methods.name: interceptDelete
methods.description: Sets up Cypress intercept for delete chart API calls.

methods.name: interceptFavoriteStatus
methods.description: Sets up Cypress intercept for fetching favorite status of charts.

methods.name: interceptUpdate
methods.description: Sets up Cypress intercept for updating a chart.

methods.name: interceptV1ChartData
methods.description: Sets up Cypress intercept for chart data API, with customizable alias.

methods.name: interceptExploreJson
methods.description: Sets up Cypress intercept for explore JSON API calls.

methods.name: interceptFormDataKey
methods.description: Sets up Cypress intercept for form data key API calls.

methods.name: interceptExploreGet
methods.description: Sets up Cypress intercept for explore GET API calls with specific query parameters.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Automates setting a filter in the UI and waits for filtering API response.

methods.name: saveChartToDashboard
methods.description: Automates saving a chart to a dashboard, including API intercepts and UI interactions.

methods.name: visitSampleChartFromList
methods.description: Automates visiting a sample chart from a list and intercepts the data fetch.
